title: Act
description: A kind of thing you do to or for someone, which they remember (D44, as Ludus's REGARD): how far it moves their regard, every time, and the line they remember it by.

regard.description: Points of regard it moves, from 0 to 100.

says.description: What is between you, said to you. {name} is their first name; {them} and {their} their pronouns.
